title: Configure Signal Strength Request
description: Backs four TELAF setters that all funnel through taf_pa_radio_SetSignalStrengthInd -> IPhone::configureSignalStrength: SetSignalStrengthIndThresholds sends `thresholds`, SetSignalStrengthIndDelta sends `delta`, SetSignalStrengthIndHysteresis sends `hysteresisDb`, SetSignalStrengthIndHysteresisTimer sends `hysteresisMs`. All four config fields are optional and the server applies only those present -- the same presence-based disambiguation data.query_profile uses. `ratSigType` names the telux::tel::RadioSignalStrengthType the config applies to.

thresholds.description: Threshold list in dBm. Max 32 entries, matching TAF_PA_RADIO_SIGNAL_STRENGTH_THRESHOLD_MAX_COUNT.
